description: PROBE 6a (U1, PR #1585 queue item 2, never previously run): seeds the Q_beta scaling map as F = exp(N*Sum_lambda g_lambda(u_L)) with the per-Wedderburn-block Delta tr_M closed forms (paper closed forms, PR #1764; leading eps-coefficients -2/-1/-2), even-in-hbar projection onto the integer u_L = b*hbar_q^2 ladder (C13 bridge change of variable), UNIFORM weights, scale fixed ONLY by the proved c_2 = -1. Reads off c_3, c_4 symbolically (constants over b) and numerically at both q0 anchors (proton-pinned from qou_substrate.constants; muon canonical). Records the anchor-stability diagnostic and two structural collapses: uniform-weight exp(Sum per-block) = exp(total), and exp-vs-linear seeding share c_3 when the seed starts at u_L^2. NOT a fit; no scan; no wiring.

anchor_stability.note: b(q0) differs only at ~1e-8 relative between the two pins, so any c_k = rational/b^m prediction is anchor-constant to ~1e-8 — it cannot track the 2.9% empirical swing (the C13 diagnostic, reproduced here for the exponentiated seed).

structural_collapses.uniform_weights_collapse: exp(N*Sum_lambda g_lambda) = exp(N*g_total): per-block structure is invisible under uniform weights; per-block weights would be a fit (forbidden without a derived weight rule)

c13_reference.note: Per-block sum is NOT proportional to the atomic Delta tr_M (q-dependent ratio, = 4 only at q = 1), so this probe tests genuinely different seed data as well as the exp form.

assertions.name: scale_fix_c2_minus1_solvable_and_exact
assertions.source: c_2 = -1 is the one proved rung (Lean N2_factor); the single scale d.o.f.

assertions.name: kill_criterion_hit_exponentiated_seed_misses_c3_gate
assertions.source: Pre-stated kill criterion: anchor-constant and far from empirical (C13 failure mode) => NEGATIVE, extend C13 scope-limited (a).

verdict.summary: Exponentiated per-block seeding (U1) gives c_3 ≈ -3.2494245 at both anchors — anchor-constant (swing 3.9e-10 vs empirical 2.9%) and 57.0% (proton) / 61.7% (muon) from the empirical c_3 — exactly the C13 failure mode. Two structural collapses make this unsurprising: (i) uniform weights collapse exp(Σ_λ g_λ) to exp(g_total); (ii) with the ladder-convention seed starting at u_L², the exponentiated and linear seedings share c_3 identically — exponentiation only moves c_4 (by +½). Scope-limited refutation (a): the exponentiated per-block Δtr_M seeding, ALONE and with uniform weights, does not reproduce c_3; it does not exclude per-block data inside a non-linear or non-uniform closure (which would need a derived, not fitted, weight rule). Extends C13: 'linear / bar-even' → 'linear, bar-even, AND exponentiated-uniform' Δtr_M-seeded f all refuted.
